dedupe_keys.name: signal permanent gnss network of slovenia rtk and rinex services

description: SIGNAL is the Slovenian network of permanent GNSS stations, run by the GNSS service of the Surveying and Mapping Authority. Its site offers real-time RTK services through an NTRIP server with published access points, a DGPS service through Telekom, RINEX data and a TOP coordinate transformation service. RINEX data holds observations from the permanent stations and from virtual reference stations created on request, for kinematic or static post-processing to centimetre accuracy, with log files describing each station. The site also has pages on equipment at the stations, reports, accuracy, the zero-order network and the effect of solar activity on GNSS. Users register with a form and sign a contract; the registration page gives subscription packages, for example a flat-rate real-time RTCM package at 829.44 euros without VAT per GNSS device for the billing period from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, and a pay-per-use option. Access is paid under the published general terms; no open licence is stated. Caveats: prices change by billing period, and the site is in Slovenian. Coverage is Slovenia. It supports studies of positioning infrastructure, deformation monitoring and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are CROPOS of Croatia and GNSSnet.hu of Hungary.
